name: Potion Bar
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Hainer
description: Potion bar mod that adds a progress bar for potions

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Progress bars for the active effects at the top centre. With speed II, regeneration and night vision given, three bars appear at the top centre, each with its effect's icon and the remaining time (4:44, 4:43, 4:42; speed marked II); the try's 'before' shot has none.
